Agent Chat and Generation
|-- [M] Modular structure: contracts, boundaries and dependencies
|   |-- Conversation interface: AgentChatPanel
|   |   |-- Exposes chat tabs, send, Read Canvas, stop, resume and pending answers
|   |   |-- Depends on chat HTTP requests + session event stream
|   |   `-- Keeps drafts, tab settings, retry identities and stream handling internal
|   |-- Conversation coordination: AgentChatService
|   |   |-- Exposes session operations, subscriptions, tool calls and canvas alternatives
|   |   |-- Depends on CodexConnection + ChatStore
|   |   |-- Optional capabilities: canvas reader, ChatTools, MCP binding,
|   |   |   GenerationCanvasBridge and saved context library
|   |   `-- Keeps native-event reduction, turn startup and generation settlement internal
|   |-- Bound canvas tools: ChatDiagramTools + MappingChatMcpBinding
|   |   |-- Exposes diagram edits, creation, extension, contexts, views and status tools
|   |   |-- ChatDiagramTools -> AgentDiagrammingSessionService
|   |   |   `-- Resolves chat references into canvas sessions and revision-aware requests
|   |   |-- MappingChatMcpBinding -> agent.chatBindings
|   |   |   `-- Maps a chat token to its canvas target and read-only setting
|   |   `-- gen-alternatives is intercepted by AgentChatService
|   |       `-- Other tool calls pass through the ChatTools contract
|   |-- Revision workflow: DiagramEditService + DiagramBatchService
|   |   |-- Exposes start, get, wait and cancel
|   |   |-- Depends on DiagramGenerator, revision/context domain logic and canvas ports
|   |   |-- DiagramEditCanvasPort exposes snapshot, apply and optional create
|   |   `-- Batch service adds one application boundary for collected edits + creations
|   |-- Execution adapters: distinct contracts
|   |   |-- StdioCodexConnection implements CodexConnection
|   |   |   `-- Chat threads and native events <-> Codex app-server over stdio
|   |   `-- PiDiagramEditRuntime extends PiAgentRuntime; implements DiagramGenerator
|   |       |-- Captured diagram request -> validated generated diagram
|   |       `-- FakeDiagramEditRuntime provides another DiagramGenerator implementation
|   `-- Canvas isolation: GenerationCanvasBridge implements CanvasSessionPort
|       |-- Child canvas IDs -> private MappingDocumentController instances
|       |-- Other canvas IDs -> supplied live CanvasSessionPort
|       `-- Reuses canvas commands; rejects unsupported child-canvas operations
|           `-- Fork management remains with the parent
|-- [C] Calls: activations and their continuations
|   |-- Conversation turn
|   |   `-- AgentChatPanel send / Read Canvas -> AgentChatService.startTurn
|   |       |-- Reject overlapping startup, running turn or tool reload
|   |       |-- Resume thread if needed; capture references; bind canvas access
|   |       |-- Persist client request ID before issuing turn/start
|   |       `-- CodexConnection.request('turn/start')
|   |           `-- Native messages -> AgentChatService.receive
|   |               |-- Item/delta -> reduce session state -> notify subscribers
|   |               |   `-- Panel event stream -> ChatStream -> transcript
|   |               |-- Question/approval -> pending request -> panel answer
|   |               |   `-- AgentChatService.answer -> connection.respond
|   |               |-- Native tool call -> callTool -> dispatchTool
|   |               |   `-- MCP entry calls callBoundTool -> same dispatchTool
|   |               |-- Turn completed -> settle items and pending interactions
|   |               |   `-- Persist terminal state; finishGeneration for child chats
|   |               `-- Parent interrupt -> cancel active children -> turn/interrupt
|   |-- Independent canvas alternatives
|   |   `-- AgentChatService.genAlternatives
|   |       |-- Require writable parent, canvas, tools and a prior user message
|   |       |   `-- A generation child cannot start nested alternatives
|   |       |-- Reuse matching request receipt; reject changed arguments for same ID
|   |       |-- Save child records -> canvas-generation(start) -> capture input history
|   |       `-- Schedule launchGeneration for each candidate independently
|   |           |-- Saved AgentContext supplied -> thread/start + inject captured context
|   |           |-- Otherwise -> thread/fork at the parent's selected turn boundary
|   |           `-- Clear inherited goal -> add isolated controller -> startTurn
|   |               |-- Child tools read and mutate only their bound canvas
|   |               `-- finishGeneration
|   |                   |-- Persist final metadata + retained child history
|   |                   |-- Finished -> sync metadata and history into candidate view
|   |                   |-- Failed/cancelled -> sync terminal metadata
|   |                   `-- Save unavailable -> retain result for later reconciliation
|   |-- Diagram edit, create or extend
|   |   `-- ChatDiagramTools.call -> prepare -> agent.submitDirect
|   |       |-- Resolve reference or explicit target against one canvas snapshot
|   |       |-- Reject stale revisions, mixed documents and invalid subtree selections
|   |       `-- DiagramBatchService.start
|   |           |-- Capture common snapshot; reject duplicate edit targets
|   |           |-- For each operation, sequentially: child DiagramEditService.start
|   |           |   `-- Snapshot/version checks -> resolve scope, template and references
|   |           |       |-- Supplied diagram -> submitStoredDiagramEdit
|   |           |       `-- Generator-backed request -> generateDiagram -> DiagramGenerator
|   |           |           `-- PiDiagramEditRuntime.generate
|   |           |               |-- Render prompt; resolve captured sources; create session
|   |           |               `-- session.prompt -> submit_diagram_edit
|   |           |                   |-- Invalid -> report issues; agent may resubmit
|   |           |                   `-- Valid -> retain candidate -> revalidate -> return
|   |           `-- Collect child applications -> canvas.batch once
|   |               |-- Success -> completed with document version and unresolved edges
|   |               |-- Version mismatch -> conflict
|   |               `-- Uncertain application -> awaiting-acknowledgement
|   |                   `-- Same request retries retained application, not generation
|   `-- Standalone DiagramEditService installation
|       |-- Edit -> apply revision or store variants; recheck document/base versions
|       `-- Create/extend -> read latest placement snapshot -> create
|           `-- Placement version conflict -> retry, at most 3 attempts
|-- [O] Ownership: state, persistence and lifetime
|   |-- AgentChatPanel owns transient interaction state
|   |   |-- Per-tab drafts/settings and pending send/read request identities
|   |   |-- Session change/unmount -> close EventSource and dispose ChatStream
|   |   `-- Closing a tab retains the conversation in history
|   |-- AgentChatService owns active session bookkeeping
|   |   |-- Sessions, thread lookup, listeners, pending interactions and delta buffers
|   |   |-- ChatStore retains conversations, generation inputs, metadata and results
|   |   |-- Restart -> running chat becomes interrupted; active generation becomes failed
|   |   `-- Disposal -> settle activity, persist status, clear bindings,
|   |       unsubscribe and dispose the Codex connection
|   |-- StdioCodexConnection owns one lazily started app-server process
|   |   |-- Owns RPC IDs, pending promises, response timers and event listeners
|   |   |-- Response -> clear timer and resolve/reject matching request
|   |   |-- Timeout -> reject request after 30 seconds
|   |   `-- Process failure -> reject pending requests and notify subscribers
|   |       `-- dispose -> kill child process
|   |-- Each generation child has its own thread, binding and controller
|   |   |-- Bridge owns controller + serialized command queue + mutation receipts
|   |   |-- Mutation -> update controller -> persist exported history -> acknowledge
|   |   |-- Receipt retained before persistence: retry can persist without reapplying
|   |   `-- Settlement -> retain history in chat, clear binding, remove controller,
|   |       unsubscribe thread; child conversation remains available for review
|   |-- DiagramEditService owns each request's generation and installation
|   |   |-- Retains generated revisions, variants, contexts and AbortController
|   |   |-- Cancel while generating -> abort; application in progress is not cancelled
|   |   `-- DiagramBatchService owns child runs and the collected final application
|   `-- Pi runtime owns active model sessions
|       |-- SessionManager persists prompts, tool calls and usage on disk
|       |-- Per generation: subscribe progress and attach abort handler
|       `-- finally -> detach handler, unsubscribe, dispose session, remove from set
`-- [D] Data dependency: what results require, independent of organization
    |-- Editable request [shared A]
    |   |-- Chat reference or explicit node ID + bound canvas target
    |   |-- Current snapshot: document version, diagram identity and base revision
    |   `-- Selected complete subtrees or whole-diagram scope
    |       `-- These determine the permitted replacement ranges
    |-- Validated revision
    |   |-- Candidate ASCII + structure kind + optional mappings/ranges
    |   |   |-- Direct submission supplies candidate content
    |   |   `-- Pi generation requires rendered template/options + instruction
    |   |       + pinned reference text + base diagram/connections
    |   |       + optional resolved AgentContext
    |   |-- Base diagram source binding/evidence + logical node identities
    |   |-- Mapping policy + permitted ranges from [shared A]
    |   `-- Validation -> parse schema, strip continuity annotations,
    |       build content, check node correspondence, diagram and scoped replacement
    |       `-- Rejected candidate receives no revision from this validation step
    |-- Applied edit result
    |   |-- Validated revision or stored variants
    |   |-- Expected document version + base revision from [shared A]
    |   `-- Canvas application receipt
    |       `-- Supplies resulting document version and unresolved edge IDs
    |-- Candidate canvas result
    |   |-- Captured source history [shared B]
    |   |   `-- Same starting history seeds independent child controllers
    |   |-- Parent conversation fork OR supplied saved AgentContext
    |   |-- Shared task + candidate prompt + inherited model/effort/tool definitions
    |   `-- Child mutation history + terminal status
    |       `-- Finished history can be synchronized to its saved candidate view
    `-- Retry decision
        |-- Request identity + argument signature -> reuse or conflict
        |-- Retained generated revision/application -> retry without a model rerun
        `-- Retained generation history -> retry saving without regenerating
